policies: St Pius X's Catechism remains the Morning/Evening source-order authority; ICKSP texts are supplementary topical devotions unless part of a distinct Office
Existing close-match canonical entries must receive full-wording comparison before duplication
The ICKSP website is a contemporary publication; source display and historical original rights/reuse must be reviewed before adding full text to the public app
Institute-specific consecrations stay identified as Institute prayers, not a universal personal formula
Historical indulgences are historical context only, never current grants
Novena/Office composite sequences should reuse common prayer IDs without duplication and preserve their source order
No paid services or source-owner contact; no deployment/merge in this inventory pass

coverage_pass2.warning: A no-match in sampled code is not proof of global absence; same subject does not mean same prayer.
